> Taste of vitae..
>
> gain all blood lost from opposing vampire yadda yadda yadda..

Well, the yadda yadda part was the important one for your question:

Taste of Vitae [Jyhad, V:TES, SW]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable after strike resolution. This vampire gains an amount of blood
equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to damage during this round
of combat. Not usable by a vampire going into torpor. Blood loss counted by
a previous Taste of Vitae is not counted again.

>
> does this mean you can play taste of vitae after stealing blood from the
> opposing vampire via Theft of vitae?

So, no:
Theft of Vitae, as a steal blood effect, does not cause _damage_ and
therefore does not meet the requirements of Taste of Vitae.
